units: Gen. R. s. 31 (ref. to Gen. VI, 16) expl. as window, and as jewel.—Du. צָהֳרַיִם noon-time.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:9">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>צהר</he>, Gen. l. c.) <he>אמר לו … מאירות לכם כצ׳</he> the Lord said to him, place in it (the ark) jewels and precious stones that they may give you light as bright as noon. Tanḥ. Kdosh. 9.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:10">Ab. III, 10</cite> <he>יין של צ׳</he> drinking wine at noon-time; a. e.
